title: Campaign mission loader: campaign.ini and the three campaign map lists strict-load
detail: Enable the Good/Evil/Angmar entries in main_menu.gd once a mission's map, scripts, and objectives load through the existing script executor. Denominator: every mission in campaign.ini plus the tutorials.
oracle: godot --headless --path game --script res://tests/campaign_mission_load_runner.gd   # prints MISSION PASS/FAIL per mission id
